faq.q: Why use Ti-5Al-2.5Sn ELI for titanium cryogenic tank clamp band?
faq.a: Ti-5Al-2.5Sn ELI retains exceptional fracture toughness at cryogenic temperatures (-253C), making it the standard for liquid hydrogen propellant tank hardware.

faq.q: How is a titanium cryogenic tank clamp band manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium cryogenic tank clamp band is manufactured using Closed-die forging; 5-axis CNC machining; Heat treatment (STA); Shot peening. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Ti-5Al-2.5Sn ELI for titanium cryogenic tank clamp band?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Machining from solid billet (90%+ material waste, no grain flow optimization).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium cryogenic tank clamp band?
faq.a: Titanium Cryogenic Tank Clamp Band components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium cryogenic tank clamp band?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86). BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.
